options.content:
**Fleet cost, from the authoritative LiteLLM bill.** Every dollar figure here is the real billed amount (`gardenio_tag_cost_usd` / `gardenio_account_cost_usd` / `gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd`, fed from LiteLLM spend logs) — not a token-count proxy. Scope with the **project** variable.
 Read it top-down: the headline row is *now*, **Cost Analysis** is *where the money went*, **Efficiency & Spend Attribution** is *what it bought* (cost per bead closed), and **Account Health** is *whether a rate ceiling is about to cap throughput*. Percentile panels read across agents: a p95 far above p50 means one agent is carrying the bill.

panels.title: Total Cost (window · real bill)
panels.description: Real LiteLLM bill accrued across all real (non-E2E) accounts over the selected dashboard window, from gardenio_account_cost_usd (the same real-bill source as the 'Spend by … (window, real bill)' panels and the /costs headline). It is a windowed DELTA (max_over_time − min_over_time on a [range:5m] subquery grid, with max by (account, env) to dedup per-pod gauge churn), so it reads the actual spend for the picked range — not a lifetime total. E2E test-account series (account=~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)") are excluded via the byte-identical matcher used by the beads-viewer by-account rollup and the /costs headline (ka-0000005167 / ka-0000001436 / ka-0000001508), so throwaway harness accounts don't appear here or in 'Cost by Account'; the exclusion is a no-op on money (every e2e series is dormant, window-delta 0) but keeps the row list clean. Replaces the former sum(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total): that counter is exported only for currently-LIVE agents and its series stop when an agent despawns, so the fleet 'total' silently dropped ~250 of ~290 agents and read ~4 orders of magnitude low, oscillating with agent churn (ka-0000001478). Cross-checks: the account-gauge window delta reconciles with the by-project/by-model tag-gauge real bill to <1% (the tag gauge carries no account label so it cannot mirror this exclusion, but a realistic e2e run's spend is pennies against the daily bill — orders of magnitude inside the <1% budget).

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time((max by (account, env) (gardenio_account_cost_usd{account!~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)"}))[$__range:5m]) - min_over_time((max by (account, env) (gardenio_account_cost_usd{account!~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)"}))[$__range:5m]))

panels.title: Working Agents
panels.description: Agents currently doing work (state="working") across all projects. Excludes prewarmed/idle/queued/spawning pods — see 'Active Agents Over Time' for the per-project/role breakdown of all states.

panels.title: Total Sessions
panels.description: Cumulative agent sessions across all projects (running total, monotonic counter)

panels.title: Deferred Agents
panels.description: Agents waiting for pod capacity as of the most recent reconcile pass. gardenio_agents_deferred_total is a GAUGE despite the _total suffix (reconciler NewDeferredMetrics: agents deferred per pass, by project+reason). The reconciler Reset()s it at the start of EVERY pass and Inc()s once per deferred agent, so an absent series does not mean the emitter is blind — it means the last pass deferred nothing. That is why a bare instant read falls outside VictoriaMetrics' 5m staleness lookback and renders noValue while the fleet is simply healthy (ka-0000002930). The zero is therefore GATED on gardenio_reconcile_total actually advancing over the last 15m: a real '0 deferred' reads 0, while a stopped or unscraped reconciler still falls through to noValue. The sparkline carries the window's history, so the big number stays a current reading and the range context is not lost. Do NOT reintroduce a bare 'or vector(0)' — that ungated form painted a confident green 0 over a blind gauge (ka-0000007164). Do NOT swap this for last_over_time over $__range either: with severity thresholds on a stat, that resurrects the last deferral anywhere in the window as if it were live (measured 2026-09-02: rendered orange '1' while the last pass deferred 0 and the newest sample was 57m old).

panels.title: Cost by Project (window · real bill)
panels.description: Real-bill spend by project over the dashboard window, from gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} (LiteLLM-synced lifetime-cumulative gauge; max by (dim, value, env) dedups per-pod churn, and max_over_time − min_over_time on a [range:5m] subquery grid is the honest window delta — same source/shape as 'Spend by Project (window, real bill)' below). Replaces the former sum(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total): that at-close counter is confirmed dead in prod (0 live series vs a ~$40k bill, ~0.06% of truth) and was retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592).

targets.expr: sum by (value) (max_over_time((max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}))[$__range:5m]) - min_over_time((max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}))[$__range:5m]))

panels.title: Cost by Account (window · real bill)
panels.description: Real-bill spend by API-credential account over the dashboard window, from gardenio_account_cost_usd (LiteLLM-synced account-cost gauge; max by (account, env) dedups per-pod churn, and max_over_time − min_over_time on a [range:5m] subquery grid is the honest window delta — same source/shape as the 'Total Cost (window · real bill)' headline). E2E test-account series (account=~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)") are excluded with the same byte-identical matcher as the headline and the beads-viewer by-account rollup (ka-0000005167 / ka-0000001436 / ka-0000001508), so throwaway harness accounts don't show as rows; because every e2e series is dormant this drops no money, only the cosmetic rows. Replaces the former sum(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total): that at-close counter is confirmed dead in prod (0 live series vs a ~$40k bill) and was retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592). Legend note: the env label is a literal "unknown" placeholder whenever GARDENIO_ENV is unset on the controller (metrics.accountEnv() falls back to "unknown" when the account bead carries no env field), which is every account in prod today — so a bare " (unknown)" suffix is stripped from the series name rather than rendered as if it were a real environment. A genuine env value still shows (ka-0000004933).

targets.expr: sum by (account, env) (max_over_time((max by (account, env) (gardenio_account_cost_usd{account!~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)"}))[$__range:5m]) - min_over_time((max by (account, env) (gardenio_account_cost_usd{account!~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)"}))[$__range:5m]))

panels.title: Cost Rate (USD/hour · real bill)
panels.description: Real-bill hourly spend rate over time, by project, from gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} — the LiteLLM-synced lifetime-cumulative gauge. increase((max by (dim, value, env) (...))[1h:5m]) reads the USD accrued in the trailing hour at each step (a per-hour rate); the max-by dedups per-pod churn and the [1h:5m] aligned subquery de-bumps the extrapolation sawtooth (same shape as the /costs fleet-rate headline, costs_rate.go). Replaces increase(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total[1h]): that at-close counter is confirmed dead in prod (0 live series) and was retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592).

targets.expr: sum by (value) (increase((max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}))[1h:5m]))

panels.title: Token Usage Over Time
panels.description: Input, output, and cache tokens over time (stacked area)

panels.title: Active Agents Over Time
panels.description: Historical active agent count by project and role. 26 (project, role) series over a 24h window overflowed the bottom list legend and pushed the plot off-panel, so the legend is a right-placed table sorted by peak concurrency — the busiest seats read off the top and the rest scroll (ka-0000004933).

panels.title: Top Spenders by Agent (real bill · sweep lookback)
panels.description: Agents ranked by real-bill cost (USD) from gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd — the per-agent LiteLLM spend-logs gauge, the only real-bill source carrying the {agent,project,role,model,account} label set. CRITICAL: this is a RAW deduped INSTANT sum (max by (agent,project,role,model,account) to collapse HA duplicates), NEVER increase(): the metric is a Reset+Set gauge whose periodic Reset trips counter-reset detection and makes increase() read inflated garbage (measured ~$27k phantom vs ~$2.7k real). Its series population is the spend-logs sweep's ~48h lookback, so the raw instant sum already yields recent-fleet spend without a window (it cannot honor 7d/30d ranges — use the by-project/account real-bill panels for longer windows). E2E/probe accounts excluded (ka-0000005167). Replaces sum(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total): that at-close counter is confirmed dead in prod (0 live series) and was retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (agent) (max by (agent, project, role, model, account) (gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd{account!~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)"})))

panels.title: Tool Call Efficiency
panels.description: Tool calls vs tool errors rate over time

panels.title: API Requests Over Time
panels.description: Cumulative API requests by project

panels.title: Context Compactions Over Time
panels.description: Compaction rate — proxy for session complexity

panels.title: Account Utilization (5h Window)
panels.description: Current 5-hour utilization ratio per account (0.0-1.0)

panels.title: Account Utilization (7d Window)
panels.description: Current 7-day utilization ratio per account (0.0-1.0)

panels.title: Account Throttle Status
panels.description: Rate-limit state per account over time, from the gardenio_account_throttled gauge (0=OK, 1=ACTIVE). E2E/probe accounts (account=~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)") are excluded as harness noise; every real account is drawn so the panel always yields a valued time series (mergeValues collapses a flat-OK account to a single green OK band). The two gauges are drawn as SEPARATE panels so each carries only one band per account: both in one panel stacked 18 y-axis rows into a half-width slot and the account labels collided (ka-0000004933). The query must not elide flat-OK accounts with an `and on(account) (max_over_time(...) > 0)` filter — that returned an EMPTY frame whenever the whole fleet was healthy (the common case), and a state-timeline with no time field renders Grafana's raw 'Data does not have a time field' error rather than the custom no-data text (ka-0000004235). The noValue message shows only if the gauge exports no series at all.

defaults.noValue: No gardenio_account_throttled gauge samples in the selected range — tracking ka-0000004235.

panels.title: Account Warming Status
panels.description: Soft-failover warming state per account over time, from the gardenio_account_warming gauge (0=OK, 1=ACTIVE). E2E/probe accounts (account=~"(?i:e2e-.*|probe-acct-.*)") are excluded as harness noise; every real account is drawn so the panel always yields a valued time series (mergeValues collapses a flat-OK account to a single green OK band). The two gauges are drawn as SEPARATE panels so each carries only one band per account: both in one panel stacked 18 y-axis rows into a half-width slot and the account labels collided (ka-0000004933). The query must not elide flat-OK accounts with an `and on(account) (max_over_time(...) > 0)` filter — that returned an EMPTY frame whenever the whole fleet was healthy (the common case), and a state-timeline with no time field renders Grafana's raw 'Data does not have a time field' error rather than the custom no-data text (ka-0000004235). The noValue message shows only if the gauge exports no series at all.

defaults.noValue: No gardenio_account_warming gauge samples in the selected range — tracking ka-0000004235.

panels.title: Cumulative Cost with Budget Thresholds (window · real bill)
panels.description: Real LiteLLM spend accumulated FROM the window start, per project and total, so the line is monotonically non-decreasing and the budget threshold lines are meaningful. Built from gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} (the real-bill per-project spend tag, same source as 'Spend by Project (window, real bill)'): running_max(...) − (... @ start()) subtracts each series' value at the window start, giving cumulative spend-since-window-open that only ever rises. Replaces the former sum(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total) plotted raw: that is a per-LIVE-agent gauge whose series vanish when an agent despawns, so the 'cumulative' line was really the instantaneous live-cohort sum — a sawtooth that FALLS on agent churn and 5h-window resets, and it read ~4 orders of magnitude low, making the $100/$500 thresholds meaningless (ka-0000001478). Thresholds retuned to real-bill magnitude ($1000 / $5000). Cross-check: the total endpoint reconciles with the per-project sum and with Panel A's account-gauge window delta to <1%.

targets.expr: sum(running_max(max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"})) - (max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}) @ start()))

sum by (value) (running_max(max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"})) - (max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}) @ start()))

panels.title: Cost per Bead Closed (window · real bill)
panels.description: Fleet efficiency: real-bill spend divided by beads closed over the dashboard window. Spend (USD/sec) from the real-bill per-project tag gauge gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} — increase((max by (dim, value, env) (...))[$__range:5m]) / $__range_s (max-by dedups per-pod churn; the [range:5m] subquery de-bumps the extrapolation sawtooth). Closes (closes/sec) from gardenio_beads_events_total{event="closed"}; the USD/sec numerator over the closes/sec denominator yields USD/close. clamp_min(...,1) on the denominator avoids a divide-by-zero spike in idle windows. Replaces sum(rate(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total)): that at-close counter is confirmed dead in prod (0 live series) and was retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592). This is the operator's headline efficiency number — are we getting cheaper per unit of delivered work?

panels.title: Cost per Bead Closed — efficiency trend (real bill)
panels.description: The cost-per-bead ratio over time (spend rate ÷ close rate, 1h windows). Spend (USD/sec) from the real-bill per-project tag gauge gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} — increase((max by (dim, value, env) (...))[1h:5m]) / 3600 (max-by dedups per-pod churn; the [1h:5m] subquery de-bumps the extrapolation sawtooth). Closes (closes/sec) from gardenio_beads_events_total{event="closed"}. Replaces rate(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total): that at-close counter is confirmed dead in prod (0 live series) and was retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592). A downward trend means the fleet is getting cheaper per unit of delivered work; an upward spike flags spend outrunning throughput (a stuck loop or a burst of expensive sessions with nothing closed).

panels.title: Spend by Model (window, real bill)
panels.description: Windowed REAL-BILL spend by model from gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="model"} — the LiteLLM /spend/tags lifetime-cumulative gauge every controller pod republishes as an absolute value, so max by (value) dedups pod churn and the subquery max-min is the honest window delta. Replaces the operator × model leaderboard on gardenio_operator_cost_usd_total: that counter is per-{pod,project,model} and controller pods churn with hourly deploys, so NO windowed aggregation over it reconciles with the bill, and 100% of its spend is operator_id="0" (unattributed) — the table was one anonymous row (ka-0000004856). Per-operator spend returns here once operator attribution resolves. Not $project-scoped: model spend is fleet-wide (the tag gauge carries one dimension per series).

panels.title: Spend by Project (window, real bill)
panels.description: Windowed REAL-BILL spend by project from gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} — the LiteLLM /spend/tags lifetime-cumulative gauge every controller pod republishes as an absolute value, so max by (value) dedups pod churn and the subquery max-min is the honest window delta. Stands in for per-operator spend until operator attribution resolves: gardenio_operator_cost_usd_total is 100% operator_id="0" today, so a per-operator panel is one anonymous bar (ka-0000004856). Reconciles with the by-account real bill to within the untagged residual (~5-10%, ka-0000003988).

targets.expr: topk(10, max_over_time((max by (value) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}))[$__range:5m]) - min_over_time((max by (value) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}))[$__range:5m]))

panels.title: Backlog Composition — beads by status
panels.description: sum by(status)(gardenio_beads_total) — the whole bead graph broken out by lifecycle status (open / closed / deferred / blocked / in_progress). Answers 'how big is the graph and what is its health mix?'. The gauge is dominated by open+closed (~300K each); the small deferred / blocked / in_progress slices are the actionable frontier drawn separately at right. gardenio_beads_total carries no project label (emitted once by the beads daemon), so this is fleet-wide and not filtered by $project. Grounded live against gardenio-vmsingle.

panels.title: Actionable Frontier — deferred / blocked / in_progress over time
panels.description: sum by(status)(gardenio_beads_total{status=~"deferred|blocked|in_progress"}) — the three statuses that represent work the fleet must act on: deferred (throttled/parked), blocked (waiting on a dependency or operator), in_progress (actively claimed). Open+closed dwarf these and are excluded so the frontier is legible. These counts had zero panels before this board (ka-0000004468). Live now ≈ deferred 339 / blocked 207 / in_progress 44.

panels.title: Per-agent spend distribution — p50 / p90 / p95 (real bill)

defaults.noValue: no per-agent spend rows in the sweep lookback — either the sweep found nothing, or the spend-log sweep is not reporting

panels.description: Distribution of per-agent billed spend across the live fleet (quantiles over gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd, one series per quantile). p50 is what a typical agent costs; a p95 an order of magnitude above it means the bill is concentrated in a few agents — chase those in the Top Spenders table above.

title: Gardenio Cost Overview
description: Fleet LLM spend and token throughput from the authoritative LiteLLM bill: cost by project, account and model, cost per bead closed, per-agent spend distribution, and per-account rate-limit headroom. Open this to answer 'what are we spending, on whom, and is it buying closed beads?'.
